dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi. There is no sign of any personage here. Only a backdrop adorns this image.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Albedo said that he wanted to leave this to everyone's imagination. Perhaps you, too, already have some clear idea of what this person might have looked like...)
